description.narrative: In the light of the recent me-too campaign and the efforts at institutional level to uphold a zero tolerance for harassment in different forms at the workplace the Embassy has identified the need to strengthen the partner organisations’ capacities to design and implement politics for prevention of sexual harassment and degrading treatment. It is proposed that the Embassy holds a capacity building workshop with the partner organisations facilitated by the Sida HQ gender expert at Eurolatin during her visit to Guatemala.
